lines: Sabko maaloom hai main sharaabi nahin
Phir bhi koi pilaaye to main kya karoon?
couplets.en: Everyone knows I am no drinker, but what can I do if someone offers me a drink all the same?

lines: Sirf ek baar nazron se nazrein milein
Aur qasam toot jaaye to main kya karoon?
couplets.en: If our eyes meet just once and my vow gives way, what can I do?

lines: Mujhko maikash samajhte hain sab baada-kash
Kyunki unki tarah ladkhadaata hoon main
couplets.en: All the drinkers take me for one of their own because I stagger as they do.

lines: Meri rag rag mein nasha mohabbat ka hai
Jo samajh mein na aaye to main kya karoon?
couplets.en: Love runs like wine through every vein, and what can I do if they cannot see it?

lines: Sirf ek baar nazron se nazrein milein
Aur qasam toot jaaye to main kya karoon?
couplets.en: If our eyes meet just once and my vow gives way, what can I do?

lines: Haal sunkar mera sahme sahme hain woh
Koi aaya hai zulfein bikhere hue
couplets.en: Someone has come with hair undone, shaken to hear how I fare.

lines: Maut aur zindagi donon hairaan hain
Dam nikalne na paaye to main kya karoon?
couplets.en: Life and death are both bewildered, and what can I do if even my last breath cannot leave me?

lines: Sirf ek baar nazron se nazrein milein
Aur qasam toot jaaye to main kya karoon?
couplets.en: If our eyes meet just once and my vow gives way, what can I do?

lines: Kaisi lat, kaisi chaahat, kahaan ki khata
Bekhudi mein hai, Anwar, khudi ka nasha
couplets.en: Why speak of habit, desire, or fault, Anwar, when losing yourself holds the intoxication of being yourself?

lines: Zindagi ek nashe ke siwa kuchh nahin
Tumko peena na aaye to main kya karoon?
couplets.en: Life itself is an intoxication, and what can I do if you do not know how to drink?
